items.name: COLLECT_MULTIPLE_OREMUS
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Oremus before first Collect and before second distinct prayer-group; a third permitted collect is grouped under the second conclusion without an extra Oremus. Unless a prayer is exceptionally linked under one conclusion, maintain proper separate conclusions and Amen boundaries.
items.currentResearchFinding: Current one fixed C0072 Oremus + opaque COLLECT_SET pair does not by itself prove dynamic second Oremus.

items.name: COLLECT_CONCLUSION_AND_AMEN
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Separate full conclusions and responsive Amen only at the ends required by the 1960 rules; one-conclusion additions must stay attached to the proper prayer.
items.currentResearchFinding: Single placeholder C0074 USER_RESPONSE cannot be accepted as proof of correct count/order.

items.name: POSTCOMMUNION_PARITY
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Use the same number, order, Oremus and conclusion arrangements as the opening collects. Amen belongs to the proper prayer boundary.
items.currentResearchFinding: POSTCOMMUNION_SET placeholder and one Oremus require branch-wise expansion.

items.name: SECRET_NO_OREMUS
items.requiredRiteBehavior: One Secret for each Collect in the same order, normally secret; do not repeat Dominus vobiscum or Oremus for each Secret. Audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum only at the concluding transition.
items.currentResearchFinding: Opaque SECRET_SET must be split in data into component Secret orations without duplicating Oremus.

items.name: LENT_ORATIO_SUPER_POPULUM
items.requiredRiteBehavior: After the normal Postcommunion(s), append a distinct Oremus and Humiliate capita vestra Deo and the Prayer over the People before the dismissal greeting, with its own conclusion.
items.currentResearchFinding: Do not mislabel as another Postcommunion, or omit if day calls for it.

items.name: ADDITIONAL_LESSONS_SEQUENTIAL
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Preserve source sequence of lesson, response and intervening prayer, with Flectamus genua / Levate where printed and actor roles dependent on Mass form; do not infer reading order from lesson numbering.
items.currentResearchFinding: One EPISTLE_OR_LESSON slot cannot certify the longer sequence by itself.

items.name: EPISTLE_DEO_GRATIAS_ACTOR
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Responsorial Deo gratias follows the lesson when the rubrics require it; distinguish priest's private voice, public lector/subdeacon and the server's or choir's response. USER_RESPONSE is a rendering role, not automatic congregational obligation.
items.currentResearchFinding: Current C0076 USER_RESPONSE is under-specified by Mass form and performer.

items.name: GOSPEL_ACTOR_CLOCK
items.requiredRiteBehavior: At Solemn Mass the deacon's public Gospel and priest's independent action/voice must be kept apart; Sung Mass may lack deacon. Keep three small Gospel crosses on correct actor and correct source words.
items.currentResearchFinding: PRIEST_ACTION and USER_RESPONSE placeholders need actor disambiguation.

items.name: CREDO_INCARNATUS_FORM_FEAST
items.requiredRiteBehavior: The celebrant genuflects when reciting Et incarnatus; at public singing, action is governed by whether he is standing or seated, with Christmas and Annunciation kneeling exceptions. Faithful posture must not mechanically copy the private celebrant's cue.
items.currentResearchFinding: Current source state C0278/C0279 are sedilia transitions with async priest/public clock.

items.name: OFFERTORY_WINE_WATER_REQUIEM
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Priest adds water to wine, but does not bless water at Requiem Mass. Difference is the blessing, not disappearance of the chalice preparation prayer.
items.currentResearchFinding: Existing Latin phrase audit specifically marks NOT_REQUIEM; preserve actor and threshold.

items.name: INCENSE_FORM_EXCEPTIONS
items.requiredRiteBehavior: First and Offertory incensation are conditional; Requiem suppresses entrance incensation, but includes distinct prescribed later incense where permitted. Solemn deacon/thurifer actor routing must not be projected as Sung priest motion.
items.currentResearchFinding: Seven conditional source cues are in non-Canon inventory; timing and people-incense start/end are visible-state signals not word patterns.

items.name: LAVABO_DOXOLOGY
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Gloria Patri and related doxology omitted under relevant Passiontide and Requiem cases, with the underlying Lavabo action retained.
items.currentResearchFinding: Check precise branch logic against 1962, not generalized penitential days.

items.name: SECRET_PREFACE_AUDIO_HANDOFF
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Secret remains inaudible until the audible concluding Per omnia; Preface dialogue audible or sung begins thereafter. Priest clock independent from Schola.
items.currentResearchFinding: No simultaneous identical index unless actual priest transition observed.

items.name: PREFACE_SANCTUS_TWO_CLOCKS
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Priest may begin secret Canon while schola is still singing Sanctus/Benedictus; do not tie priest position to sung Benedictus text. Priest sign at Benedictus text and bows are source-scoped actions.
items.currentResearchFinding: Existing 48-card regressions must not determine liturgical identity.

items.name: PATER_NOSTER_RESPONSE_ROLE
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Pater is said or sung audibly by priest according to form; Et ne nos inducas concludes before Sed libera nos a malo response; verify performer and voice distinctions by form.
items.currentResearchFinding: C0210 is response, not priestly silent prayer.

items.name: AGNUS_STRIKE_REQUIEM
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Ordinary: priest strikes breast at each of three invocations; Requiem: wording changes to dona eis requiem, third with sempiternam, and priest omits breast strikes. Do not duplicate faithful customary action automatically.
items.currentResearchFinding: Current three priest source events B01 and B03 are clearly distinct; Requiem branch must not inherit crosses.

items.name: PAX_SOLEMN_ONLY
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Ministerial Pax handed from priest to deacon and subdeacon only where prescribed; no universal free-form congregational exchange, no deacon in Missa Cantata.
items.currentResearchFinding: Avoid actor/presentation conflation in right priest rail.

items.name: SECOND_CONFITEOR_OMITTED_1962
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Extra Confiteor/Misereatur/Indulgentiam before laity's Communion is historical customary only; strict 1962 starts at Ecce Agnus Dei. Optional branch must be visibly labelled nonnormative.
items.currentResearchFinding: Seven current donor cues are historic optional; no default promotion.

items.name: ECCE_ONCE_DOMINE_THRICE
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Ecce Agnus Dei once, Domine non sum dignus three times, followed by Communion distribution. Do not misread an English translation suggesting Ecce repeated.
items.currentResearchFinding: Different from priest's previous Domine non sum dignus C0229–C0231.

items.name: COMMUNION_CHANT_ABLUTION
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Communion chant may continue during distribution and overlap with priest's communion and purification phases; distinguish priest and Schola clock and actual communicants. Priest retains finger discipline until ablutions.
items.currentResearchFinding: C0249/C0250 slots do not represent priest station by themselves.

items.name: DISMISSAL_BRANCH_VOICE
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Ite missa est / Benedicamus Domino / Requiescant in pace depend on rite; Deo gratias vs Amen response must be correctly assigned to the formula. At Solemn deacon sings Ite; at Missa Cantata priest sings it.
items.currentResearchFinding: Single fixed Ite source prayer cannot be displayed on every day.

items.name: BLESSING_AND_LAST_GOSPEL
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Final blessing omitted after Benedicamus Domino and Requiescant in pace. Last Gospel John 1 is normative where present, with 1962 omissions and Palm Sunday proper special cases. Priest genuflects at Et Verbum caro.
items.currentResearchFinding: Do not suppress Last Gospel automatically whenever blessing suppressed; independent rubrical conditions.

items.name: LAY_POSTURE_NOT_PRIEST_RUBRIC
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Faithful posture and gestures require proper period/community or observed local evidence; do not copy the priest's bows, crosses and breast strikes into left rail automatically.
items.currentResearchFinding: Persistent state events have source conditions, some non-cue; no synthetic default when unresolved.

items.name: MISSA_CANTATA_NOT_SOLEMN
items.requiredRiteBehavior: Solemn Mass assigns deacon/subdeacon/thurifer actions distinctly. Missa Cantata has no deacon or subdeacon; source witness must retain exact actor and applicability.
items.currentResearchFinding: 54 sourced solemn minister events outside Canon are research-only conditional lane.
items.sourceLocator: Ritus VI, VII, X, XI; solemn minister batch02

policy: Every listed behavior is a source-to-implementation test gate, not proof current app fails under every branch.
Never implement proposed corrections without checking actual renderer branch, 1962 Latin and 1960 general rubrics.
Actor roles separate priest, server, deacon, subdeacon, Schola and faithful.
Two or three Collects do not imply two or three independent Oremus in all cases: group and conclusion rules govern.
Historical second Confiteor opt-in may be displayed only clearly non-normative.
